subject: POC onboarding: org setup, API keys, allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@curasense.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@curasense.com
Date: 2027-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initiating POC — infrastructure and MAP items

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at CuraSense is excited to move forward with a short evaluation. To get the PoC moving we need to align on a Mutual Action Plan and a list of technical prerequisites we can close in the next three weeks. Key items we need Redwood to provide or confirm: 

- Organization setup: a sandbox org for us to test multi-tenant behavior and role-based access.
- API keys: ephemeral keys for the PoC, and a pattern for rotation.
- IP allowlist: our infra team needs the list of egress IPs to add to our firewall.
- VPC peering: we will likely request peering for low-latency calls — can you share the required CIDR ranges and peering steps?

I attached a short requirements doc (CuraSense-PoC-Requirements.pdf) with network contact info. Can we target a kickoff next Tuesday (2027-09-14) and close activation by 2027-09-28? That timeline is important for our internal demo to clinical ops.

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
Head of Platform
CuraSense

Attachment: CuraSense-PoC-Requirements.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@curasense.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Initiating POC — infrastructure and MAP items

Maria — great to hear, and thanks for the clear list. I pulled together a draft MAP that splits the PoC into three milestones (Org + Keys, Network Allowlist + Tests, Optional VPC Peering). I attached the workbook (MAP_CuraSense_v1.xlsx) — the high-level dates match your requested window.

High level commitments from Redwood: 
- Sandbox org will be provisioned by 2027-09-10 with admin invites for two CuraSense users.
- We will issue short-lived API keys for the PoC; recommended TTL: 24 hours with automated rotation scripts.
- IP egress list (for allowlisting) included in sheet "Network Specs" — please confirm your firewall team can accept the /24 ranges listed.
- VPC peering is an optional upgrade; we can start peering prep immediately but expect a 7–10 business day window once network tickets are opened.

Next actions: 
1) Please confirm the two users to be added as org admins.
2) Share the primary network contact for peering (name + email + expected maintenance windows).
3) If the timeline above looks good I will open a DocuSign SOW and schedule a technical kickoff.

Tagged Neha and Priyom to own the sandbox provisioning and peering coordination.

—Rishi
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_CuraSense_v1.xlsx
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@curasense.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Chen <tim.chen@curasense.com>, CuraSense Procurement <procurement@curasense.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T18:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Initiating POC — infrastructure and MAP items

Thanks Rishi — timeline looks reasonable. Confirming: please add the following two org admins: me (maria.gonzalez@curasense.com) and Tim Chen (tim.chen@curasense.com).

Network contact for peering: Tim Chen (tim.chen@curasense.com). Maintenance window: prefer weekdays 02:00–06:00 UTC to avoid clinical hours. We can accept the /24 ranges as long as you can provide a single-point CIDR list for firewall rules.

A couple of questions: 
- For the ephemeral API keys, do you have an example rotation script or an SDK helper we can use?
- For data-in-transit encryption, confirm that all traffic will be TLS1.3 and that mutual TLS is available if needed.

Procurement has asked for a short SOW and signature path so they can commit budget — please route the DocuSign to procurement@curasense.com.

Regards,
Maria

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-09T08:12:00Z
Subject: Internal: CuraSense peering & keys — preflight checklist

Internal notes (do not forward to customer):
- Neha: can you provision the sandbox org and add Maria + Tim as admins by EOD 2027-09-10? Steps: create org ID CURA-TEST-01, grant Admin and Billing roles.
- API keys: recommend we issue initial API key pairs with a 24-hour TTL and provide a small rotation snippet (Python) that calls /v1/keys/rotate. I uploaded a sample rotation helper to our internal KB: https://kb.redwood.com/poctools/rotate-sample (internal).
- Network: request the exact /24 list we will announce. For peering: require customer ASN, their VPC CIDR, and preferred maintenance window (we have the 02:00–06:00 UTC window; good).
- Security: confirm TLS1.3 across endpoints; mTLS available but will require customer certificate exchange; escalate to Security if they request HSM-backed mutual auth.

Planned deliverables by 2027-09-10: org provisioned, initial keys issued, allowlist CIDRs shared. Priyom will own peering ticket once requested by customer.

—Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@curasense.com>, Tim Chen <tim.chen@curasense.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, CuraSense Procurement <procurement@curasense.com>
Date: 2027-09-09T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Initiating POC — infrastructure and MAP items

Maria / Tim — thank you, all set. Summary & next steps: 

- Sandbox org (CURA-TEST-01) will be live by 2027-09-10; admin invites are going to maria.gonzalez@curasense.com and tim.chen@curasense.com.
- Initial ephemeral API keys will be issued today; we will email a secure link with the rotation helper (Python) and an example for Node. Keys are 24-hour TTL by default; we can shorten if you prefer.
- Allowlist CIDRs: 54.213.120.0/24, 54.213.121.0/24, 3.129.46.0/24 (these are the egress pools for the PoC). Please confirm Tim can add these to your firewall.
- VPC peering: Priyom will open the peering ticket; Tim, please share your VPC CIDR and ASN when you have a minute. Expect 7–10 business days for peering once tickets are in.
- DocuSign SOW: sent to procurement@curasense.com (link: https://redwood.app/docusign/RDW-3421). Please sign so we can schedule the production-equivalent test and demo.

Proposed kickoff: 2027-09-14 16:00 UTC — 45 minute technical kickoff (calendar invite to follow).

If anything needs to shift to meet clinical ops windows, flag here and we’ll adapt. Looking forward to getting you into the sandbox.

Best,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Activation-Checklist.md
